text:
I thought CAP meant "pick two of three." That framing confused me for years.

CAP isn't a menu. It's a statement about one specific moment: what happens during a network partition.

• CP systems choose consistency
• AP systems choose availability
• You don't "skip" partition tolerance in a distributed system

PACELC extends the idea to normal operation: latency vs consistency when the network is fine.

Ever wondered why your "strongly consistent" cache still serves stale reads? That's what this post digs into.
